title: clinical database design research: code tables, the store, sources, the profile and time
note: basis 'shown' means shown by reading the code on master 2040ca24 or by the timings of section 4 on this session's 4-core container with synthetic data; 'hypothesis' means inferred and not run on the product's own path.

findings.claim: the code tables loaded at install have two homes: tools/terminology_install.py writes TB_TERMINOLOGY_DIR, which the compiler reads, while services/omop/vocab_load.py never reads that folder, so a table loaded at install does not reach omop.concept (D-301's one home; D-1181 expands value sets for the store)

in the compiled screening SQL each criterion joins its fact table against the inline value-set list with a correlated EXISTS; at 300,000 synthetic patients this is 46 to 54 percent of operator time for GZQO and RA-BIO, while a one-pass value-set hit table builds in 0.25 to 0.32 s

a query of 100 patients costs 24 to 46 percent of the whole 300,000-patient query because the pid filter restricts only base and not the fact subqueries, so a run sliced into patient batches repeats most of the fixed work per slice (not run with the product's own slice size)

D-1093 (notes read and indexed as written inside the box) is not yet reflected: the lake's full-text index and the vector index still mask note text before chunking (services/lake/store.py, services/vec/index.py; D-439 item 3, DATA section 11)

a fact read from a note has no versioned, cited home in the store of record: NOTE_NLP keeps term, status and offset, but no note-text hash, quote hash, extractor version, supersede chain or confirm state, so a confirmed fact cannot be traced to the note version it came from after the note changes at the source
JJ1017, the TW and JP standard department codes and ICD-11 have no licence register row and no loader; JJ1017's terms of reuse are not stated on JSRT's page

the OMOP store has no composite (concept, date, person) index; on 699,400 synthetic conditions a 6-month window query fell from 26.0 ms with the official person and concept indexes to 12.6 ms with it, and a latest-value query is helped only by a materialised view (24 to 48 ms against 104 ms)

a stored event date is a point with no precision, so a month- or year-precise source date is refused or pinned to a day and a window cannot answer possibly-within; what each source's date means is fixed per lake column, not recorded per source
the patient twin is built only for study patients and has no search structure over its layers, so a hospital-wide profile search reads every twin or runs the cascade
